name: Stylized supply crate modeling trial
status: Standalone trial delivered for owner visual review; not installed in the game
authoring: Direct native Blender geometry, authorized modeling experiment; not Tripo reconstruction
dimensions_include: All battens and iron nail heads
materials: Painted wood with gentle tangent normal
Front wood with flat cream lettering and gentle tangent normal

textures.wood_albedo: Original approved beam wood albedo, unchanged sRGB
textures.wood_normal: Original approved gentle OpenGL tangent normal, unchanged linear data
textures.front_albedo: Existing wood plus native flat serif lettering via colour-only emission projection

lighting: No studio lighting or AO added to textures; preview lights, camera and floor excluded from GLB
limitations: Static closed trial; no opening animation, collision, hotspot or puzzle logic.
Lid is separate and can translate upward; its origin matches the floor origin. No hinge pivot is implied.
Simple interior geometry was authored for this trial; the closed reference does not specify its construction.
Wood colour and normal tile repetition inherits the original approximate edge continuity.
The game toon shader must consume the supplied tangent normals through its own lighting calculation.
